messages.text: T2 retains Guild discretion with Lantern Council attached to NG and replaces MJ with military autonomy, attaching Vigil Home to MA. Planned orders are Repair and Restraint, with no Warrant. The pledges bind assignments only; each needs its owners' fresh signatures. We offer a defensible independent army accepting a month without combat, rather than surrendering its future choices. Repair and ordinary consumption should leave Communities two and Readiness three, before any undisclosed effects. The Navigation and Military approvals remain separate.

reason: My colleague's proposed Vigil pledge makes autonomy's institutional duty concrete. I recognise that this gives up Guard. Our readiness buffer permits restraint now, while the Guild's repair contribution warrants Navigation discretion. This row assumes nobody's consent.
